newsitem.title: USA: TVA 1,065 MW Ala. nuke seen on line Thurs.
newsitem.headline: TVA 1,065 MW Ala. nuke seen on line Thurs.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's 1,065 megawatt Browns Ferry nuclear power unit 3 was expected to resume electricity production on Thursday from a refueling outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.

The unit, located in Decatur, Ala., was "exiting refueling outage" as of early Wednesday and "plan to enter startup this morning and to place unit on line tomorrow," the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Wednesday.
Browns Ferry 3 was taken off line Feb 22 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The adjoining Browns Ferry 2 nuclear unit was operating normally at 100 percent of its 1,065 MW capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said in the report.
